classification.difficultyReason: Compare five horizontal translations of an absolute value graph on one coordinate system.

content.prompt: On the same set of axes, sketch the graphs of $y=|x-h|$ for $h=-2,-1,0,1,2$.

answer.short: Five upward V-shaped graphs with vertices $(-2,0)$, $(-1,0)$, $(0,0)$, $(1,0)$ and $(2,0)$ respectively; each has branch gradients $-1$ and $1$.
answer.worked: Translate $y=|x|$ horizontally by $h$ units: left for negative $h$ and right for positive $h$. The vertex is $(h,0)$, and the branch gradients remain $-1$ and $1$. Sketch all five graphs on the same axes.

spec.sourceRegion: 21D question 2; answer book PDF page 34, Section D question 2
spec.description: Five upward absolute value graphs on one shared coordinate system, with vertices at the five specified horizontal shifts. The source answer has no grid.
spec.mathematics: y=|x-h| for h=-2,-1,0,1,2; vertices (h,0), branch gradients -1 and 1.
